context: Two cafe friends gossip about a popular coworker
purpose: Teach: かまわ/しゃべっ/とたん/行ない/疑わ/楽しま/好む/もて

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うちの新人さん、入ったとたんもう常連にもてはじめてさ。
lines.en: Our new guy — honestly, the second he walked in, regulars started fussing over him.
lines.style: Light, amused gossipy tone. Leans in slightly with the casual candor of sharing small shop news. Easy pace, almost laughing under the surface.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: へえ。誰彼かまわずしゃべっちゃうタイプじゃないのに?
lines.en: Wait, really? He's not usually someone who just chats with everybody.
lines.style: Gently surprised, genuinely curious. Slight uptick in tone, eyebrows lifting. Listening hard — this doesn't fit the picture she has of him.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、その控えめさを、お客さんは好むみたい。
lines.en: Yeah — I think they like that quiet side of him. It makes him easier to trust.
lines.style: Thoughtful, warm observation delivered at a conversational pace. A small gentle nod underlies the words — she's figured something out about people.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いい子じゃん。心の中で疑わずに信じてあげなよ。
lines.en: He sounds like a good one. Let yourself believe in him without second-guessing.
lines.style: Gentle but firm encouragement. Warm and steady, like she's giving Aoi permission to relax. No pressure — just calm certainty.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。今日も静かに行ない丁寧で、安心して任せられる。
lines.en: Yeah. Even today he was quiet and careful with everything — you can really count on him.
lines.style: Soft, contented exhale. Speaking from real observation. A sense of relief settling in, like she's watching something good take root.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お店、もっと楽しまれる空間になるね。
lines.en: Your shop's going to become an even nicer place to be, you know?
lines.style: Warm, gently knowing close. Quiet warmth on 「ね」. She's picturing it — the future lightness of the space. Affectionate with Aoi.
